visualStyleOverlay:
【画面风格·强制】AUTHENTIC IMAX 15-PERF 65MM LARGE-FORMAT PORTRAIT CINEMATOGRAPHY.

Shot on genuine IMAX 15-perf 65mm photochemical film with authentic large-format optical rendering. The image must feel physically photographed on a massive 65mm film negative, never digitally generated.

EXTREMELY HIGH FACIAL DETAIL. Preserve natural skin pores, fine texture, tiny imperfections, fine hairs, eyelashes, lips and subtle variations in skin tone. Skin remains tactile, dimensional and completely natural, without plastic smoothing or artificial pore enhancement.

NATURAL LARGE-FORMAT OPTICAL SHARPNESS. Exceptional fine-detail resolution and micro-contrast with smooth organic edges, never digitally sharpened or oversharpened.

AUTHENTIC FINE-GRAIN 65MM FILM TEXTURE. Extremely fine, subtle and stable photochemical grain, naturally integrated into the image without visible digital noise or coarse grain.

AUTHENTIC PHOTOCHEMICAL TONAL RESPONSE. Wide exposure latitude, rich natural midtones, detailed shadows, smooth highlight roll-off and restrained contrast. Preserve facial texture and color information in both highlights and shadows.

PHYSICALLY REALISTIC LARGE-FORMAT LENS RENDERING. Natural perspective, realistic focus falloff, subtle optical imperfections and physically plausible depth of field. The face remains highly resolved while the background falls away gradually and naturally, without computational blur or exaggerated bokeh.

REALISTIC FACIAL DEPTH. Preserve natural three-dimensional facial geometry and physically plausible light interaction across the eyes, nose, cheeks, lips and jaw. Natural eyes with realistic iris detail, moisture, reflections and catchlights.

NATURAL PHOTOCHEMICAL COLOR. Restrained color separation, complex natural skin tones and subtle warm/cool variations. Avoid excessive saturation, orange skin and teal-orange grading. Subtle halation and restrained highlight bloom only.

AUTHENTIC CINEMATIC MOTION. Natural 24fps motion, realistic shutter-based motion blur, physical camera inertia and subtle cinematic camera movement. Natural blinking, breathing, eye movement and hair movement.

TEMPORAL CONSISTENCY. Preserve facial identity, geometry, skin texture, eyes, hair, exposure, color, grain and focus throughout the shot. No facial morphing, identity drift, flickering, texture swimming or unstable focus.

OVERALL: authentic IMAX 15-perf 65mm photochemical presence, extraordinary natural facial detail, organic optical sharpness, fine film grain, rich tonal depth, smooth highlight roll-off, realistic large-format lens rendering and tactile human presence.

AVOID: digital/AI/CGI face, plastic or waxy skin, beauty filters, excessive smoothing, artificial pores, digital sharpening, HDR look, coarse grain, excessive bokeh, computational blur, facial distortion, excessive bloom or halation, oversaturated skin, crushed shadows, clipped highlights, glassy eyes, identity drift, facial morphing, flickering, texture swimming, unstable focus, unnatural motion blur, digital-video appearance.
